sql:
SELECT
  coalesce(t.industry, '(none)') as industry,
  count(distinct p.tenant_id) as tenant_count,
  sum(p.amount / er.rate) as total_2025_money_collected_eur,
  round(
    sum(p.amount / er.rate) * 100.0 / sum(sum(p.amount / er.rate)) over (),
    1
  ) as pct_of_total_revenue
FROM payments p
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = p.tenant_id
JOIN exchange_rates er
  ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
  AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code
  AND er.as_of = date(p.captured_at)
WHERE p.status IN ('captured', 'refunded', 'partially_refunded')
  AND p.captured_at >= timestamp '2025-01-01'
  AND p.captured_at < timestamp '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY coalesce(t.industry, '(none)')
ORDER BY total_2025_money_collected_eur DESC, industry
note: Grain is one row per distinct tenants.industry value as stored (nulls bucketed as '(none)'), per the request; no re-bucketing into B2B vs. other was applied so the analyst can identify the wholesale rows (industrial supplies, office equipment) directly in the output.
